ai_knowledge_pool.title: Knowledge Pool Management
ai_knowledge_pool.desc: To enable the AI to respond, you need to continuously provide new data to the infrastructure.
ai_knowledge_pool.way1_desc: Add technical specifications or user manuals as PDFs directly to the database.
ai_knowledge_pool.way2_desc: When you provide current 'How-To' URLs to the system, the AI reads your website and saves it to its memory.
ai_knowledge_pool.way3_desc: You can create 'Instructions' for the assistant by manually entering FAQs.
ai_knowledge_pool.pdf_desc: Add technical specifications, user manuals, and other documents as PDFs directly to the database.
ai_knowledge_pool.pdf_item1: The system automatically splits the PDF into Embedding (Vector) chunks.
ai_knowledge_pool.pdf_item2: Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD.
ai_knowledge_pool.pdf_item3: The AI can use this content immediately after the upload finishes.
ai_knowledge_pool.scraper_desc: When you provide current "How-To" URLs to the system, the AI reads your website and saves it to its memory.
ai_knowledge_pool.scraper_item1: Add a URL and the system automatically crawls the page.
ai_knowledge_pool.scraper_item2: Content can be kept up to date with periodic refreshes.
ai_knowledge_pool.scraper_tip: Only public, accessible URLs can be crawled. Pages requiring login are not supported.
ai_knowledge_pool.raw_desc: You can manually enter frequently asked questions and their answers to build "Instructions" for the AI.
ai_knowledge_pool.raw_item1: Enter content in a question-and-answer format.
ai_knowledge_pool.raw_item2: Ideal for company policies and procedures.
ai_knowledge_pool.tip_quality_desc: The quality of the content you add to the Knowledge Pool directly affects the quality of the AI's answers. Add current, accurate, and comprehensive documents.

ai_learning_cycle.title: Learning Cycle
ai_learning_cycle.desc: AI automatically learns from closed tickets. This cycle ensures that more accurate and faster responses are generated over time.
ai_learning_cycle.works_title: How Does the Learning Cycle Work?
ai_learning_cycle.step1_desc: When a closed ticket is rated 5 stars by the customer, the system marks this solution as "excellent".
ai_learning_cycle.step2_desc: The solution is not directly written to the main database. It is first sent to the KB Approvals tab.
ai_learning_cycle.step3_desc: You can choose to let AI learn this solution (Approve) or skip it (Reject).
ai_learning_cycle.step4_title: Approved solution is added to Knowledge Pool
ai_learning_cycle.step4_desc: The approved solution is added to the vector database and used for similar questions in the future.
ai_learning_cycle.faq_desc: You can manually trigger the learning cycle from the FAQ Management page. The system analyzes closed tickets and automatically extracts frequently asked questions.
ai_learning_cycle.faq_item1: Trigger the pipeline with the "Start Extraction" button.
ai_learning_cycle.faq_item2: Extracted FAQ candidates fall into the review queue.
ai_learning_cycle.faq_item3: Approved FAQs are added to the knowledge base.
ai_learning_cycle.tip_active_desc: Encourage customers to give a satisfaction score when the ticket is closed to keep the learning cycle running effectively.

ai_approvals.title: AI Approvals (KB Approvals)
ai_approvals.desc: 5-star solutions and FAQ candidates pass through admin approval before being added to the main database. This maintains information quality.
ai_approvals.step1_desc: Click the KB Approvals link from the left menu.
ai_approvals.step2_desc: For each candidate, the source ticket, suggested Q&A pair, and confidence score are displayed.
ai_approvals.step3_desc1: Approve — The solution is added to the Knowledge Pool and begins to be used by AI.
ai_approvals.step3_desc2: Reject — The solution is skipped and not added to the database.
ai_approvals.score_desc: The system calculates a confidence score for each candidate. A high score indicates that the solution strongly matches similar questions.
ai_approvals.tip_qa_desc: Read the source ticket before approving. Make sure the solution is genuinely accurate and repeatable.
ai_approvals.bulk_item1: You can perform bulk approval or rejection by selecting multiple candidates.
ai_approvals.bulk_item2: View candidates in a specific product or category using filters.

ai_faq.title: FAQ Management
ai_faq.desc: The system automatically extracts frequently asked questions from closed tickets. From this page, you can review, publish, or reject FAQ candidates.
ai_faq.auto_desc: The system periodically analyzes closed tickets and marks recurring questions as FAQ candidates.
ai_faq.manual_desc: You can run the pipeline manually with the Start Extraction button.
ai_faq.approval_item1: Approve — FAQ is published and added to the knowledge base.
ai_faq.approval_item3: Confidence score and source ticket info are displayed for each candidate.
ai_faq.tip_cycle_desc: FAQ Management and KB Approvals work together. Check both pages regularly for the complete learning cycle.

tickets_overview.title: Support Request Management
tickets_overview.desc: Learn how to handle and manage all incoming customer requests.
tickets_overview.pool_desc: The Support Requests page is where all requests from customers are collected.
tickets_overview.pool_item1_desc: After entering the ticket, you can change the status (Open, Replied, Closed) from the dropdown in the right panel.
tickets_overview.pool_item2_desc: You can delegate the ticket to a specific expert agent using the "Assign" button.
tickets_overview.pool_item1: Filter by status, priority, company, and date range.
tickets_overview.pool_item2: Select multiple tickets for bulk actions.
tickets_overview.pool_item3: Tickets with an SLA breach are marked with a red badge.
tickets_overview.status_desc: You can change the status from the dropdown menu in the right panel on the ticket detail page.
tickets_overview.status_item1_desc: When you start reviewing the request
tickets_overview.status_item2_desc: When you start actively working on it
tickets_overview.assignment_desc: You can hand off the request to a specific specialist agent using the Assign button on the ticket detail page.
tickets_overview.assignment_item1: The assigned agent receives an email notification.
tickets_overview.assignment_item2: Assignments can be changed; past assignments are logged.
tickets_overview.tip_sla_desc: SLA rules can automatically route unassigned tickets to the appropriate team. Configure SLA rules from the Team Management page.

tickets_internal_notes.title: Internal Notes & Team Communication
tickets_internal_notes.desc: Improve team coordination by taking notes that the customer won't see.
tickets_internal_notes.usage_desc: Use the Internal Note (Team Only) tab on the ticket detail page.
tickets_internal_notes.tip_desc: Saving solution steps as internal notes in critical cases guides other agents when a similar case arises.
tickets_internal_notes.step1_desc: Find the tabs above the reply box.
tickets_internal_notes.step2_desc: Switch to the Internal Note (Team Only) tab. Messages on this tab are not visible to the customer.
tickets_internal_notes.step3_desc: Write the information you want to share with team members. Notes are marked with a yellow background to distinguish them from normal replies.
tickets_internal_notes.tip_warning_desc: Messages sent while on the internal note tab are not delivered to the customer. Make sure to switch to the Reply tab to respond to the customer.
tickets_internal_notes.workflow_item1: Click the Assign button in the right panel on the ticket detail page.
tickets_internal_notes.workflow_item2: Select the appropriate agent from the dropdown list.
tickets_internal_notes.workflow_item3: The assigned agent receives an email notification and the ticket appears in their list.
tickets_internal_notes.workflow_item4: Assignment history is recorded in the ticket activity log.

tickets_ai_copilot.title: Using AI Co-Pilot
tickets_ai_copilot.desc: Respond to tickets 10x faster with AI assistance.
tickets_ai_copilot.usage_item1: When you enter a ticket, press the "Generate AI Draft" button in the top right.
tickets_ai_copilot.usage_item2: The system scans the customer's message and your knowledge pool. It prepares a professional draft citing sources within 5-10 seconds.
tickets_ai_copilot.usage_item3: You can approve, edit, and instantly send the draft to the customer.
tickets_ai_copilot.step1_desc: Open the support request you want to respond to.
tickets_ai_copilot.step2_desc: Click the button in the top-right corner. The AI process takes 5-10 seconds.
tickets_ai_copilot.step3_desc: The AI scans the customer's message and the Knowledge Pool to prepare a draft. Source documents are listed below.
tickets_ai_copilot.step4_desc: Edit the draft to match your own tone, then send it to the customer.
tickets_ai_copilot.how_item1: The customer's message is matched against documents in the Knowledge Pool using vector search.
tickets_ai_copilot.how_item2: The most relevant documents are used as context.
tickets_ai_copilot.how_item3: A professional draft reply is generated and its source documents are shown.
tickets_ai_copilot.tip_edit_desc: AI drafts are a starting point. We recommend editing them to match your own tone and situation-specific details before sending them to the customer.

team_teams.title: Team & Department Structure
team_teams.desc: Define expertise groups in your organization.
team_teams.team_item1: Create departments like Technical Support, Sales, Licensing.
team_teams.team_item2: Assign agents to these teams and determine authority levels.
team_teams.step1_title: 1. Go to the Team Management page
team_teams.step1_desc: Click the Teams link in the left menu.
team_teams.step2_desc: Enter a team name and description (e.g. "Allplan Technical Support").
team_teams.step3_desc: Select the agents to include in the team. An agent can belong to more than one team.
team_teams.step4_desc: Set response time, resolution time, and business hours rules for the team.
team_teams.tip_auto_desc: Once the team and SLA rules are configured correctly, the system automatically assigns incoming tickets to the relevant team based on product category.

team_sla.title: SLA Policies
team_sla.sla_item2: Define target first response time based on criticality levels (Low, Medium, High).
team_sla.param1_desc: The maximum time within which the first reply must be given after a ticket is opened.
team_sla.param2_desc: The maximum time within which the ticket must be fully resolved.
team_sla.param3_desc: The time range during which the SLA counter runs. It can be paused outside business hours.
team_sla.table_note: * These values are an example configuration. Customize them from the Team Management page.
team_sla.vio_item1: The system sends an automatic alert when the SLA is about to expire.
team_sla.vio_item2: Breached tickets are marked in the ticket list with a red SLA_VIO badge.
team_sla.vio_item3: SLA breach statistics are shown on the dashboard.
team_sla.tip_hours_desc: Configure business hours correctly so the SLA counter pauses outside working hours. Otherwise SLA breaches can occur on weekends and holidays.

tickets.title: Ticket Pool
tickets.desc: The Support Requests page aggregates all incoming requests from customers into a single pool. You can perform status management, assignment, and prioritization operations here.
tickets.pool_desc: The ticket pool lists all active and past support requests. Manage your workload with filters and sorting options.
tickets.status_desc: You can change the status from the dropdown in the right panel after entering the ticket detail page.
tickets.assignment_desc: You can delegate the ticket to a specific expert agent using the Assign button on the ticket detail page.
tickets.tip_sla: SLA rules can automatically route unassigned tickets to the appropriate team. Configure SLA rules from the Team Management page.

ai_copilot.title: AI Co-Pilot
ai_copilot.desc: AI Co-Pilot analyzes the customer message, finds relevant documents from the Knowledge Pool, and prepares a professional response draft.
ai_copilot.step1_desc: Open the support request you want to respond to.
ai_copilot.step2_title: Click the 'Generate AI Response Draft' button
ai_copilot.step2_desc: Click the button in the top right corner. The AI process takes 5-10 seconds.
ai_copilot.step3_desc: AI presents the draft it prepared by scanning the customer message and Knowledge Pool. Source documents are listed below.
ai_copilot.step4_desc: Edit the draft according to your own style and send it to the customer.
ai_copilot.tip_edit: AI drafts are a starting point. It is recommended to edit them according to your own style and situation-specific details before sending to the customer.

internal_notes.title: Internal Notes & Assignment
internal_notes.desc: Internal notes allow you to communicate within the team without being visible to the customer. Use the assignment feature to route tickets to the right expert.
internal_notes.step1_desc: Find the tabs above the reply box.
internal_notes.step2_desc: Switch to the Internal Note (Team Only) tab. Messages in this tab are not visible to the customer.
internal_notes.step3_desc: Write the information you want to convey to team members. Notes are marked with a yellow background to distinguish them from normal replies.
internal_notes.tip_warning: Messages sent while in the internal note tab are not delivered to the customer. Make sure you switch to the Reply tab to respond to the customer.

ai_knowledge.title: Knowledge Pool Management
ai_knowledge.desc: You need to keep the Knowledge Pool continuously updated for AI to generate accurate answers. You can add data in three different ways.
ai_knowledge.pdf_desc: Add technical specifications, user manuals, and other documents directly to the database as PDFs.
ai_knowledge.scraper_desc: When you provide current How-To URLs to the system, AI reads your website and saves it to its memory.
ai_knowledge.tip_scraper: Only publicly accessible URLs can be scraped. Pages requiring login are not supported.
ai_knowledge.raw_desc: You can create Instructions for AI by manually entering frequently asked questions.
ai_knowledge.tip_quality: The quality of the content you add to the Knowledge Pool directly affects the quality of AI responses. Add up-to-date, accurate, and comprehensive documents.

learning_cycle.title: Learning Cycle
learning_cycle.desc: AI automatically learns from closed tickets. This cycle ensures more accurate and faster responses are generated over time.
learning_cycle.how_title: How Does the Learning Cycle Work?
learning_cycle.step1_desc: When a closed ticket is rated 5 stars by the customer, the system marks that solution as perfect.
learning_cycle.step2_desc: The solution is not written directly to the main database. It is first sent to the KB Approvals (AI Approvals) tab.
learning_cycle.step3_desc: You can choose to have the solution learned by AI (Approve) or skipped (Reject).
learning_cycle.step4_title: Approved solution is added to Knowledge Pool
learning_cycle.step4_desc: The approved solution is added to the vector database and used for similar questions in the future.
learning_cycle.faq_desc: You can manually trigger the learning cycle from the FAQ Management page. The system analyzes closed tickets and automatically extracts frequently asked questions.
learning_cycle.tip_active: To keep the learning cycle active, encourage customers to give satisfaction scores when tickets are closed.

approvals.title: AI Approvals (KB Approvals)
approvals.desc: 5-star solutions and FAQ candidates go through admin approval before being added to the main database. This preserves knowledge quality.
approvals.step1_desc: Click the KB Approvals link in the left menu.
approvals.step2_desc: For each candidate, the source ticket, proposed Q&A pair, and confidence score are displayed.
approvals.step3_approve: Approve — The solution is added to the Knowledge Pool and starts being used by AI.
approvals.step3_reject: Reject — The solution is skipped and not added to the database.
approvals.tip_quality: Read the source ticket before approving. Make sure the solution is truly correct and repeatable.

faq.title: FAQ Management
faq.desc: The system automatically extracts frequently asked questions from closed tickets. From this page you can review, publish, or reject FAQ candidates.
faq.auto_desc: The system periodically analyzes closed tickets and marks recurring questions as FAQ candidates.
faq.manual_desc: You can run the pipeline manually with the Start Extraction button.
faq.tip_loop: FAQ Management and KB Approvals work together. Check both pages regularly for the complete learning cycle.

announcements.title: Create & Publish Announcements
announcements.desc: Follow the 4-step process to send bulk or targeted announcements (campaigns, maintenance notifications, etc.) to your customers.
announcements.step1_desc: Design and save email content you can reuse in the Templates tab.
announcements.step2_desc: Write new content in the Create Announcement tab or apply a template from the top menu.
announcements.step3_desc: Use the filters on the right to determine which industry or company the announcement will be sent to. The system instantly shows you the number of people to be reached.
announcements.step4_desc: When you press the Protocol Draft button, your announcement is saved as a Draft. No emails are sent yet. Find the relevant announcement from the History tab and click the Publish icon to send the actual emails to the selected audience.
announcements.tip_test: Test your draft announcements in preview mode before sending. Real emails are only sent when the Publish icon is clicked.

templates.title: Template Library
templates.desc: Create reusable email templates. Templates speed up the announcement creation process and ensure consistent communication.
templates.step1_desc: Click the Announcements link in the left menu.
templates.step2_desc: Switch to the Templates tab at the top of the page.
templates.step3_desc: Enter the template name, subject line, and email content. HTML format is supported.
templates.step4_desc: The template is added to your library and can be used when creating announcements.
templates.tip_update: Don't forget to update all templates when company information or contact details change.

system_settings.title: General Settings
system_settings.desc: Manage platform-wide configuration settings. Configure CRM integration, email notifications, and system parameters here.
system_settings.view_desc: This page shows system administrators the overall health status of the infrastructure.
system_settings.telemetry_desc: Visit the AI Health & Telemetry page for more detailed AI performance metrics.
system_settings.tip_readonly: The System Topology page is for monitoring purposes only. Contact your system administrator for infrastructure configuration.

settings.title: General Settings
settings.desc: Manage platform-wide configuration settings from this page. Configure CRM integration, email notifications, and system parameters here.
settings.crm_desc: Configure Dynamics 365 integration to automatically synchronize customer and company data.
settings.step1_desc: Click the Settings link in the left menu.
settings.step3_desc: Map CRM fields to system fields. Incorrect mapping can lead to data inconsistencies.
settings.step4_desc: Start a manual synchronization with the Trigger Synchronization button and check the results.
settings.tip_careful: Changes on the Settings page affect the entire system. Especially take a backup before changing CRM field mappings.

profile.title: Profile Management
profile.desc: Update your personal information, change your password, and manage your account preferences.
profile.step1_desc: Click the My Profile link at the bottom of the left menu.
profile.step2_desc: Update information such as first name, last name, phone number, and job title.
profile.step3_desc: Click the Save button to apply your changes.
profile.language_desc: You can change the platform interface language from your profile page. Turkish and English are supported.
profile.tip_password: Use a strong password containing uppercase/lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters for account security. Change your password regularly.

system_settings.crm_desc: Configure Dynamics 365 integration to automatically synchronize customer and company data.
system_settings.crm_step1_desc: Click on the Settings link in the left menu.
system_settings.crm_step3_desc: Map CRM fields to system fields. Incorrect mapping can lead to data inconsistencies.
system_settings.crm_step4_desc: Start a manual synchronization using the "Trigger Sync" button and check the results.
system_settings.other_item1: Email Notifications: Configure email templates for ticket updates.
system_settings.other_item2: Language Settings: Set the platform default language.
system_settings.other_item3: Security: Set session duration and password policies.
system_settings.tip_warning_desc: Changes on the settings page affect the entire system. Always take a backup before changing CRM field mappings.

system_topology.title: System Topology
system_topology.desc: The System Topology page displays the infrastructure components of the platform and the status of AI nodes in real-time.
system_topology.view_desc: This page shows system administrators the overall health status of the infrastructure. The following components are monitored:
system_topology.view_ai_desc: Status of Ollama and vector computation nodes
system_topology.view_db_desc: Number of active DB nodes and connection status
system_topology.status_warning: Warning: There is a performance drop or delay.
system_topology.telemetry_desc: Visit the AI Health & Telemetry page for more detailed AI performance metrics.
system_topology.telemetry_item2: RAG accuracy rates and confidence distribution
system_topology.tip_readonly_desc: The System Topology page is for monitoring purposes only. Contact your system administrator for infrastructure configuration.

ai_knowledge_learning_cycle.title: Learning Cycle
ai_knowledge_learning_cycle.desc: The system learns from every interaction to improve response quality.
ai_knowledge_learning_cycle.cycle_desc: When customers give 5 stars to closed tickets, the system considers that solution perfect and sends it to the AI Approvals pool.

ai_knowledge_approvals.title: AI Approval Pool
ai_knowledge_approvals.desc: Approve automatically generated or successful solutions to transfer them to the AI's permanent memory.
ai_knowledge_approvals.process_item1: Review: Review article drafts derived from tickets by AI.
ai_knowledge_approvals.process_item2: Approve: Add correct ones permanently to the Knowledge Base by clicking 'Approve'.

ai_knowledge_faq.title: FAQ Management
ai_knowledge_faq.desc: Automatically identify and publish frequently asked questions.
ai_knowledge_faq.auto_desc: AI reports which topics are candidates for 'Frequently Asked Questions' by analyzing ticket traffic.

system_settings_topology.title: System Topology
system_settings_topology.desc: Monitor data flow, integrations, and AI model status.
system_settings_topology.monitor_desc: See connection health between vector database, LLM APIs, and server resources.

system_settings_settings.title: Global System Settings
system_settings_settings.desc: Configure global parameters across the platform.
system_settings_settings.config_item1: Default language and time zone settings.

system_settings_profile.title: Admin Profile
system_settings_profile.desc: Manage your own account settings and notification preferences.
system_settings_profile.security_desc: Manage two-factor authentication (2FA) and password updates from here.

my_tickets_create.title: Creating a New Support Request
my_tickets_create.desc: You can create a new record from the 'My Support Requests' page to forward your issue to agents.
my_tickets_create.tip_ai_desc: Try resolving your issue with the AI Assistant before opening a ticket. Most technical questions can be answered in seconds.
my_tickets_create.step1_desc: After clicking the New Request button, select the product family (e.g. ALLPLAN).
my_tickets_create.step2_desc: Enter a clear title and details explaining the problem. Select urgency level.
my_tickets_create.step3_desc: A system info file (.hxl) is required for Allplan errors. If saved in your profile, it's added automatically.
my_tickets_create.step4_desc: Attach screenshots or log files and create the request.
my_tickets_create.tip_crash_desc: If the program closes, freezes, or shows an error dialog, attach a screenshot, exact error text, Hotinfo file, and crash dump if available.
my_tickets_create.step5_desc: Review the information and create the request. You will receive an email notification once it is created.
my_tickets_create.priority_low: General questions, documentation requests, or issues that do not block work.
my_tickets_create.priority_medium: Technical issues that affect daily work but have a temporary workaround.
my_tickets_create.priority_high: Serious issues affecting an active project delivery or multiple users.
my_tickets_create.priority_urgent: Production stoppage, critical license access, or anything fully blocking work.

my_tickets_attachments.title: File Attachments & Security
my_tickets_attachments.desc: Learn how to add files to your support requests to speed up the resolution process.
my_tickets_attachments.acc_note1: Suitable for screenshots and visual error records.
my_tickets_attachments.acc_note2: Use for PDF, Office files, and text-based descriptions.
my_tickets_attachments.acc_note3: Useful when sending several files in a single package.
my_tickets_attachments.acc_note4: Use for Hotinfo, logs, crash dumps, and configuration files.
my_tickets_attachments.acc_note5: Attach short videos to show the issue on screen.
my_tickets_attachments.rej_note1: Executable or system files cannot be uploaded directly.
my_tickets_attachments.rej_note2: Code, app package, or disk image files are blocked for security reasons.
my_tickets_attachments.rej_warning: If you need to send these files, package them in a safe archive first and add a note for the support team.
my_tickets_attachments.tip_crash_desc: For Allplan crashes, attaching the .hxl Hotinfo file and any available .dmp crash dump can significantly shorten diagnosis time.
my_tickets_attachments.limit_types: Supported types: Images, PDF, Word, Excel, ZIP, Log, and Allplan Hotinfo files.
my_tickets_attachments.security_desc: For security reasons, executable files (.exe, .dll, .bat, .py) cannot be uploaded directly. You can send such files inside a ZIP or 7Z archive.

my_tickets_tracking.title: Request Tracking & Communication
my_tickets_tracking.desc: Learn how to track the status of your requests and communicate with agents.
my_tickets_tracking.status_open: Open: Your request has reached the system and is waiting for assignment.
my_tickets_tracking.status_replied: Replied: An agent has responded, waiting for your review.
my_tickets_tracking.status_closed: Closed: The issue is resolved and the record is archived.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_new_desc: The request was created and saved in the system.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_open_desc: The request is visible to the support team and waiting for assignment.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_in_progress_desc: An agent is working on your request.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_waiting_desc: The support team is waiting for additional information or files from you.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_solution_desc: An agent shared a solution; please check the result.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_resolved_desc: The issue was marked as resolved.
my_tickets_tracking.stat_closed_desc: The request was archived and removed from active processing.
my_tickets_tracking.app_step1_desc: Apply the shared steps and check whether the issue is resolved.
my_tickets_tracking.app_step2_desc: If the solution worked, approve the request. If not, reply in the same ticket.
my_tickets_tracking.csat_desc: Your rating on closed tickets helps improve support quality and the AI learning loop.
my_tickets_tracking.tip_csat_desc: Even a one-sentence comment helps us understand which solutions really worked.

knowledge_base_overview.title: Using the Knowledge Base
knowledge_base_overview.desc: Browse the repository of articles containing solutions to the most common technical problems.
knowledge_base_overview.search_desc: You can search with keywords (e.g. 'Installation error') using the search bar on the knowledge base page.
knowledge_base_overview.categories_desc: Access relevant documents using categories divided by products or modules.
knowledge_base_overview.search_step1_desc: Type the error message, product name, or operation name into the search field.
knowledge_base_overview.search_step2_desc: Narrow results by product, category, or article type.
knowledge_base_overview.search_step3_desc: Follow the steps in order and open a support request if needed.
knowledge_base_overview.type1_desc: Step-by-step process explanations and usage guides.
knowledge_base_overview.type2_desc: Solutions for errors, installation, licensing, and performance issues.
knowledge_base_overview.type3_desc: Items to check before opening a support request.
knowledge_base_overview.type4_desc: Resources that improve learning and product usage.
knowledge_base_overview.stat2_desc: Not published yet or waiting for review.
knowledge_base_overview.stat3_desc: Content is being enriched with new information or documents.
knowledge_base_overview.tip_ai_desc: If you cannot find an article, ask the AI Assistant the same question or create a support request.

profile_settings.title: Profile & Settings
profile_settings.desc: Manage your personal information and system data used in support processes.
profile_settings.hotinfo_desc: By uploading your Allplan Hotinfo file here, you can ensure it is automatically attached during ticket creation.
profile_settings.notifications_desc: Determine in which cases you want to receive email notifications.
profile_settings.update_step1_desc: Keep your name, phone, and company details current so the support team can identify you correctly.
profile_settings.update_step2_desc: Your email address is used for notifications and password reset. If it is wrong, contact the support team.
profile_settings.update_step3_desc: After updating the form, remember to save. Some CRM fields can only be changed by the support team.
profile_settings.pass_item1: Refresh your password regularly. Use a strong and unique password.
profile_settings.pass_item2: Check the password reset email. Review both inbox and spam folders.
profile_settings.pass_item3: Ask support for account access issues. New accounts cannot be created without CRM verification.
profile_settings.hotinfo_item1: Keep your Hotinfo file current. System data speeds up technical diagnosis.
profile_settings.hotinfo_item2: Upload again after a new computer or version change. Old Hotinfo data can be misleading.
profile_settings.tip_email_desc: Password resets, ticket notifications, and agent replies are sent to your registered email address.

getting_started_announcements.title: System Announcements
getting_started_announcements.desc: Follow important updates, maintenance notifications, and new release notes from here.
getting_started_announcements.type1_desc: Information is provided in advance about planned server maintenance and temporary access restrictions.
getting_started_announcements.type2_desc: Details about new tools and improvements added to the platform are shared.
getting_started_announcements.tip_desc: Critical announcements are also sent to your registered email address.
getting_started_announcements.read_item1: Open the Announcements page to view active system messages.
getting_started_announcements.read_item2: Check affected product, date, and required action in the announcement details.
getting_started_announcements.read_item3: For critical announcements, also follow your email notifications.
getting_started_announcements.type1: Maintenance: Planned downtime, server maintenance, or temporary access restrictions.
getting_started_announcements.type2: New feature: New tools, screens, and process improvements added to the platform.

ai_assistant_overview.title: Using the AI Assistant
ai_assistant_overview.desc: You can resolve your issue in seconds with the AI Assistant before opening a support request. The assistant scans the entire knowledge base and provides step-by-step solutions.
ai_assistant_overview.usage_step1_desc: Click on the 'AI Assistant' tab in the left menu.
ai_assistant_overview.usage_step2_desc: Type the error or the topic you want to learn in the message box.
ai_assistant_overview.usage_step3_desc: The AI will return a reliable response based on documentation.
ai_assistant_overview.rag_desc: The AI Assistant uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology. This means the assistant scans the company's technical knowledge pool before generating a response.
ai_assistant_overview.rag_item1: Your query is matched with relevant documents via vector search.
ai_assistant_overview.rag_item2: A contextual answer is generated from the matched documents.
ai_assistant_overview.rag_item3: Source documents are listed below the answer.
ai_assistant_overview.tip_rag_desc: The assistant checks approved articles and uploaded documents before generating an answer. The clearer your product, version, and error text are, the more accurate the result will be.
ai_assistant_overview.no_answer_title: What Happens If No Answer Is Found?
ai_assistant_overview.no_answer_desc: If the AI cannot find a suitable answer to your question, it automatically suggests creating a support ticket.
ai_assistant_overview.tip_no_answer_title: You can still open a support request
ai_assistant_overview.tip_no_answer_desc: If the AI answer is not enough, create a ticket from the same flow. Your question and attached files are passed to the support team as context.
ai_assistant_overview.tip_desc: Specify the software module name in your questions (e.g. AX3000). This ensures the AI finds more accurate results.

ai_assistant_tips.title: Tips for Effective Questions
ai_assistant_tips.desc: Techniques to get the most accurate answers from the AI Assistant.
ai_assistant_tips.do_item1_desc: Write which software module (e.g. AX3000) you are experiencing problems with.
ai_assistant_tips.do_item2_desc: Paste the exact error code you see on the screen.
ai_assistant_tips.do_item3_desc: Explain during which operation, screen, and step the issue occurs.
ai_assistant_tips.dont_item1_desc: Avoid open-ended phrases like 'There is an error'.
ai_assistant_tips.dont_item2_title: Mixing multiple topics in one question
ai_assistant_tips.tip_pro_desc: Asking your questions in English may allow the AI to access a wider global database.

my_tickets.title: Create New Support Request
my_tickets.desc: You can create a new record from the My Support Requests page to forward your issue to the support team.
my_tickets.tip_try_ai: Try resolving your issue with the AI Assistant before opening a support request. Most technical issues can be answered within minutes.
my_tickets.step1_desc: After clicking the New Request button, select the product family you are experiencing the problem with (e.g. ALLPLAN, AX3000). This routes your request directly to the relevant expert team.
my_tickets.step2_desc: Enter a clear title and details explaining the problem you encountered. Select the urgency level (determined by SLA).
my_tickets.step3_desc: A system information file (.hxl) is required for Allplan errors. If there is a saved Hotinfo on your profile page, it is added automatically.
my_tickets.tip_crashes: For crash situations, attach the .hxl Hotinfo and .dmp crash dump files from the %AppData%\Nemetschek\Allplan directory. This significantly speeds up diagnosis.
my_tickets.step4_desc: Click the Create Request button. You will receive an email notification when your request is created.
